info.name: Learning
info.summary: Spaced Repetition Learning with Leitner System
info.description:
**Learning** is a powerful flashcard and quiz app for Nextcloud with built-in Leitner spaced repetition system.
Features: - 📚 Multiple Choice Quizzes - 🧠 Leitner 5-Box Spaced Repetition - 👥 Share Pools with Nextcloud Groups - 📊 Progress Tracking & Statistics - 📁 Import from CSV/JSON - 📱 Mobile Optimized
Perfect for: - Employee Onboarding - Compliance Training (DSGVO, ISO) - IT Certification Prep (CompTIA, Cisco) - University Courses - Knowledge Retention
info.author: Andre
